Note that all of the elements on the Periodic Table are neutral. That’s because they are neutral, they don’t have a charge.

             Atomic Number = Number of Electrons for a Neutral Element

To recap, the atomic number for Gold (Au) is the whole number above the element symbol.  It is defined as being the number of protons of that element, and only that element.  Au, with Atomic Number 79, will always have 79 protons.
